info.name: HubSpot Analytics Events Access Tokens Subscriptions API

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor for pagination to get the next page of results.

params.name: properties
params.description: A comma-separated list of property names to return.

items.docs: Returns a page of commerce subscription records. Use the limit and after parameters to paginate through subscriptions. You can also specify which properties to return using the properties parameter.
Creates a new subscription record with the provided properties. Subscription records track recurring revenue relationships with customers.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the subscription to retrieve.

params.name: properties
params.description: A comma-separated list of property names to return.

items.docs: Returns a single subscription record by its ID. You can specify which properties to return using the properties parameter.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the subscription to update.

items.docs: Performs a partial update of a subscription record. Only the properties included in the request body will be updated; other properties will remain unchanged.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the subscription to archive.

items.docs: Archives (soft deletes) a subscription record by its ID. Archived subscriptions can be restored using the HubSpot UI or API.
Searches for subscription records using filter groups, sorts, and other query parameters.
